summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 14, 2026. The proposals included the re-election of ten directors, reappointment of the statutory auditor, authorization for ordinary share issuances, approval of share incentive plan awards, and renewal of share purchase authorization. All proposals were approved by shareholders. This filing is a routine shareholder meeting result and does not constitute a special situation event. No deal terms or pricing were mentioned.
